parent_objective: audit diffuse completed taxonomy outcome dominance before repair, synthesis, or comparison
blocked_by: M1767 classifies completed taxonomy outcome dominance as diffuse across all scenario families and profiles

public_gates: M1768 must use only existing M1767 localization artifacts and M1766/M1764 context
M1768 must decide whether the next route is task-quality repair design, metric-semantics audit, branch synthesis, bounded diagnostic panel, or stop
M1768 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles or rank controller families
M1768 must preserve the claim boundary that M1767 is diagnostic outcome localization only

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether diffuse completed-taxonomy dominance should route to repair, semantics, synthesis, diagnostic panel, or stop
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result-audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1767 artifacts are internally inconsistent
stop if the audit cannot choose a next route without ranking controller families
stop if branch synthesis cadence fires before another implementation or design milestone
fallback_plan: route to task-quality repair design if outcome dominance has clear repair targets
route to metric-semantics audit if mitigation or diagnostic roles require different interpretation
route to branch synthesis if diffuse dominance makes further local repair too narrow
route to bounded diagnostic panel if a reduced non-ranking panel is needed before repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1767 reports diffuse outcome dominance across all families and profiles

admission_evidence: M1767 completed no-rollout localization with 864 rows, 305 dominant slices, 291 target slices, all 6 families, all 12 profiles, and zero guardrail violations
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review updates
next_stage_criteria: M1768 chooses a next route with explicit claim boundary
ranking remains blocked unless the audit gives a new non-confounded basis
any follow-up branch respects synthesis cadence

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; M1768 audits task-quality outcome dominance and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M1768; preserve profile metadata for later self-ID gates.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1767 completed public diagnostic localization artifact only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat diffuse dominance as task-quality evidence and keep it separate from self-identification claims.
allowed_claims: next-route decision under no-rollout process guardrails
no controller ranking, private-holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1767 diffuse outcome dominance can be audited into a concrete next route without ranking controller families.
success_criteria: M1768 makes the next route explicit
M1768 preserves no-rollout no-training no-ranking and no-paper-claim guardrails
failure_criteria: audit runs new rollout or changes configs
audit ranks controller families from M1767
audit claims paper-level or level3 evidence

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1767 localization artifacts without rollout

decision_rule: M1768 passes if it audits M1767 and routes the next branch without ranking or paper-level claims.
